glasses_omar: I assumed nightstand_b1, but it was at coffee_table_l1 at 08:45. Pattern: Highly variable; moves between bathroom, living room, and bedroom. Do not assume a fixed spot; check coffee_table_l1, bathroom_shelf_ba1, and nightstand_b1.

razor_omar: I assumed sink_ba_ba1, but it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 at 07:02. Pattern: Location varies between shelf and sink. Check both bathroom_shelf_ba1 and sink_ba_ba1.

mug_omar: I assumed kitchen_table_k1, but it was at coffee_table_l1 at 10:57. Pattern: Highly inconsistent; does not follow a simple morning/evening split. Check coffee_table_l1, kitchen_table_k1, and cupboard_k1. Avoid assuming sink_k1 or fixed evening living room spots.

charger_omar: I assumed entry_hook_e1, but it was at coffee_table_l1 at 13:04. Pattern: Inconsistent; can be in entry at night but moves to living room during day. Check coffee_table_l1, entry_floor_e1, and entry_hook_e1.

water_bottle_omar: I assumed pantry_shelf_k1 (08:41) and coffee_table_l1 (20:32), but it was at coffee_table_l1 and dish_rack_k1 respectively. Pattern: Moves between living room and kitchen. Check coffee_table_l1, dish_rack_k1, and pantry_shelf_k1.

glass_omar: I assumed cupboard_k1, but it was at sink_k1 at 22:59. Pattern: Remains in the kitchen at night, specifically at the sink, not in storage. Check sink_k1 and cupboard_k1.

General: Items do not follow consistent time-based patterns. Evening locations are dynamic. Always consider multiple rooms (kitchen, living, bedroom, entry) rather than assuming a single fixed spot based on time of day. Specific sub-locations (floor vs hook, sink vs cupboard, table vs cupboard) are critical for accuracy.
